card.name: Hedging words in label statements
card.fires_on: Words in drug-label sentences that introduce an explanation or an expectation, such as 'evidence' in 'no body of evidence', 'expected', and the 'e' of 'i.e.'.

modes.label: No body of evidence
modes.description: The word evidence or available in the phrase 'no body of evidence available from controlled trials'.

modes.label: Expected to be
modes.description: The word expected in a prediction about drug exposure or effect.

modes.label: i.e. clarifier
modes.description: The e in i.e. that opens a clarifying list in parentheses.
